subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow details should OpenClaw show directly to users, and how should session/channel identifiers be redacted?
rationale: Current code already carries token, budget, model, route, and session facts, but exposing raw identifiers or exact provider/model context details changes privacy and support behavior.

options.title: Show redacted diagnostics
options.body: Expose provider/model, effective context budget or model limit, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted channel/session label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.

options.title: Keep specifics operator-only
options.body: Keep chat copy generic and document the log/status path operators should use for detailed context-pressure facts.

options.title: Fold into broader context visibility
options.body: Defer this issue until a broader context-visibility design decides shared UI, logs, and channel-message behavior together.

recommendation.title: Show redacted diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose provider/model, effective context budget or model limit, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted channel/session label while keeping raw identifiers in logs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has prior detailed review context on this exact issue and adjacent compaction history, making him the best routing owner for the visible-field/redaction policy choice.
